pages.text: Day 112. The $(item)Horizon Diver$() takes me through an event horizon. Rule one: $(thing)carry a Geodesic Anchor$(). Without one, tidal forces kill within two seconds - in the black hole and the white hole alike.

Why the tides kill: near a black hole, gravity changes so steeply over the length of a body that the feet are pulled far harder than the head. The stretching is called $(thing)spaghettification$(), and it is not a figure of speech.

Even anchored, it is hostile down here. Time is dilated: I move, swing and dig slower. Gravity is 2.5 times as strong. Below y=16 the singularity tears everything apart. $(thing)Tidal Horrors$() hunt in the dark, and their touch $(thing)spaghettifies$().

Log, second descent. An $(item)Einstein-Rosen Bridge$() stands at 0, 121, 0. I stepped through and came out inside the $(thing)white hole$() - a black hole run backwards, which nothing can enter, only leave. Low gravity, blinding light, everything pushed outward. The $(thing)Photon Moths$() here are harmless.

Neither side is enough alone. From the black hole: $(item)Tidal Alloy$() and $(item)Frozen Photons$(). From the white hole: $(item)Retrocausal Crystals$() and $(item)Primordial Ejecta$(). Together they make the $(item)Einstein-Rosen Core$() - and with it, new bridges I can build myself.
Crosses an event horizon - inward. Use again to come back out, which should be impossible.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
Keeps your worldline your own. Without one, the inside of a black or white hole kills you in two seconds.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
Both ends of a bridge between a black hole and a white hole, held in one hand.$(br2)Made in $(item)Tesseract Assembler$().
Light that reached the horizon and stopped there, red-shifted to nothing.$(br2)Made in $(item)Neutron Star Forge$().
It formed after you mined it.$(br2)Made in $(item)White Hole Emitter$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Einstein-Rosen Core$(): Einstein-Rosen Bridge, Spacetime Singularity$(li)$(item)Frozen Photon$(): Einstein-Rosen Core, Stress-Energy Tensor$(li)$(item)Retrocausal Crystal$(): Einstein-Rosen Core
$(thing)Tidal Horror$(). Lives in: Inside the Black Hole.$(br)Drops: Tidal Alloy Scrap, Frozen Photon.
$(thing)Photon Moth$(). Lives in: Inside the White Hole.$(br)Drops: Primordial Ejecta, Retrocausal Crystal.

$(thing)Dimension data: Inside the Black Hole$()$(br2)$(thing)Nature$(): Gravity 1000 g, 3 spatial dimensions, time x0.01, ordinary vacuum.$(br2)$(thing)Carry$(): $(item)Geodesic Anchor$() - with it, gravity x2.5, Time Dilation II; below y=4 the singularity spits you out of the White Hole.
$(thing)Natives$(): Tidal Horror.$(br2)$(thing)Landmarks$(): Anomaly Vault Black Hole Interior, Ore Tidal, Ore Frozen Light.
